title: Great tour & tour guide!
text: Teresa was great! Very informative and always looking out for her tour group. We forgot our umbrellas and when it started to rain she was so kind and let us use hers. She made the tour fun & was very knowledgeable!
author: F7628ESshelbym

title: Small group tour is ideal. Giovanna is pretty much an expert.
text: Giovanna gave one of the best, most interesting tours on our cross Portugal Spain trip. She was engaging and interesting with in depth knowledge of Sagrada Família. The small group is our preference allowing as many questions needed and no time spent waiting for wandering tourists.
author: gregenmexico

title: Amazing and Flexible!
text: Helena was incredible. She was perfect for the kids and so accommodating. We really appreciated the flexibility with the schedule and timing because of the futbol match. It made our trip less stressful and very enjoyable! Thank you!
author: KristinR888

title: All Gaudi tour was great
text: We did a similar tour to this except it was all Guadi highlights… did not include the Gothic area. Instead we did Guadi’s first house Casa Vicens - which we really enjoyed. Olga E did a great job tying together Guadi’s life and work - for us to understand this brilliant artist better. After 4 times in Barcelona using Rick Steve’s guides… the 5-hours we spent with Olga E. made us really appreciate what we were seeing and Guadi’s genius. Plus, she takes amazing pictures!  Bravo Olga E.
author: JJZCandJ

title: First time to Barcelona...
text: First time to Barcelona and wanted to deep dive into the Gaudi works and city history without getting stuck in crowds. This was a great solution for us.
author: CHRISTI_S

title: Great overview of Barcelona with Isabel!
text: Wonderful day with Isabel for this family of 3 from Los Angeles. Sagrada Familia, Guell Park, Barcelona Cathedral,  Palau de la Musica and more. We spent seven hours together, and it was extremely informative and entertaining. Highly recommended.
author: Happiness578338

title: Wonderful full day tour of Barcelona
text:
My partner and I had the most wonderful day with LivTours on the Full Day Barcelona Tour. From the moment we met our guide Teresa (even though we were late, apologies again!), we felt in safe and knowledgeable hands.

Teresa was warm, funny, professional, and incredibly knowledgeable about Barcelona’s history, art, and culture. Her excellent time management and seamless coordination allowed us to relax and enjoy the day, knowing everything was taken care of. title: Fantastic tour!
